title: Logged hours on the right invoice
description: The intervals are tied to a client, a project and a rate that has been checked.

blocks.text: A total amount of time doesn’t explain which work belongs on a particular document.

quote.text: For me, the best part of this service occurs on the back end, tallying the hours logged using the app. You can log your hours thru the web or the iPhone app, and then feed that info into your projects and ultimately into your invoices.

blocks.text: Before billing, show the intervals, the pauses and the entries already used. Allow a forgotten timer to be corrected, and the job an entry belongs to.
A recorded minute is not necessarily agreed to be paid for; what goes in needs looking over.
